notes.title: WINDFALLERS
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dp5fD0A.gif[/img]
[h1]
[olist]
[*]Sign contract
[*]Get thrown by a trebuchet
[*]Complete the contract
[*]Get paid
[*]Make new friends
[/olist]
[/h1]

[h1]📯Featuring📯

"Sword Time"[/h1]
[h2]It's like "bullet time" but with swords. [/h2]

[h1]"Trebuchets"[/h1]
[h2]Do I really need to define this? Can you girlfriend throw you 300 yards? No? I didnt think so.[/h2]

[h1]"Stealth Assault"[/h1]
[h2]Like when you're stealthy until your found, then you're a whirlwind of steel and death.[/h2]

[h1]"Infinite Ammo"[/h1]
[h2]It's just like regular ammo, just infinite [/h2]


[h3][b]But seriously, enjoy the prototype demo! I know there's a lot of other games you could be playing and I appreciate you choosing to play this one 😁

And come give a shout on the Warcube server
(because I do not yet have a server for Windfallers, and I would feel pretentious to name the server after myself...)[/b][/h3]
[h2][url=https://discord.gg/warcube]Discord Fam 🍰[/url][/h2]
